_comment: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored) and replace every <...> value. No secrets in this file: the Worker ingest secret lives in Windows Credential Manager under ingestCredentialTarget.
reportId: <numeric id of the saved report, from its admin URL>
_browserChannelComment: null = Playwright's bundled Chromium. Use "chrome" or "msedge" if the bundled build will not start on this PC.
_profileDirComment: Optional absolute path of an existing browser profile to share (e.g. one another collector keeps signed in to Shopify). Runs wait up to profileWaitMinutes while another program has it open.
_vendorMasterComment: Optional. Products Master vendor tabs that say which supplier each product comes from (used when several suppliers share one Shopify location, so Shopify's vendor no longer tells them apart). Public CSV export of the sheet; the sheet id and tab gids stay in config.local.json. sku/name/link are column headers ('SKU#1' = the first column named SKU). keepShopifyVendors keep the Shopify vendor.
_signInWaitComment: Minutes a headed run waits for a person to finish signing in (2FA) before giving up. 0-120.
_periodsComment: What a scheduled run collects (dates in timeZone). daily: kinds collected every run. closedMonths: on these days of the month, re-collect the last `lookback` full months so later corrections are kept (an unchanged month writes nothing). backfill: each run also fills up to maxPerRun missing full months, newest first, back to `earliest` (YYYY-MM) or until Shopify returns no data. All proposals: change them freely.
_shipstationComment: Market data: ShipStation Insights > Reports > Product Sales, collected for the same periods. baseUrl is the ShipStation host you land on after signing in (for example https://ship<N>.shipstation.com). Remove this section to skip market data.
